content: I'm working on a network driver for MAC Privacy Protection protocol (IEEE 802.1AEdk). There are a number of abstractions which need to be added to make this possible. My understanding is that I can (and should) start submitting patches for abstractions sooner rather than later to avoid submitting a very large patch series in the future. This will be my first contribution, so I'm still trying to understand the process. Should I submit a PR to https://github.com/Rust-for-Linux/linux/tree/rust-next? Should I submit an RFC patch series to net-next upstream? Thanks in advance.
Abstractions should be submitted to the relevant subsystems, i.e. where you would normally have submitted equivalent/related C code.
In case you haven't seen it, please take a look at: https://rust-for-linux.com/contributing#submitting-new-abstractions-and-modules
